items.Sentence: The headworks includes... a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen...

Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process using extended retention of biological solids... The repeated cycling of environments nitrifies and denitrifies the wastewater... With the separate zones, the aeration system can achieve biological nitrogen removal.

Two 50-feet diameter, 16-feet side-water-depth secondary clarifiers remove the biomass associated with the secondary treatment process and produce a clarified effluent ready for disinfection and final discharge.
The flocculation well... permits natural flocculation of the biomass contained in the mixed liquor.
Secondary effluent can either flow by gravity or be pumped to the chlorine contact basins where chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate.
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin.
The basin is scheduled to be dredged, dewatered, and dredged
During dry weather, effluent is recycled for dry-weather maintenance of the Hiller storm water treatment wetland...
During dry weather, effluent is recycled for... irrigation of agricultural lands.
